references.use: 主要画法/丰富中间色/真实使用关系
实际设计的平面/尺寸/镜头/动线/光照和材料色；不是最终画面风格

prompt:
Create a NEW purposefully designed commercial anime RPG interior background. Reference image 1 (Girls' Frontline 2 personal room) is the PRIMARY art/colour/material-quality reference: harmonious rich middle colours, warm and cool neutrals, credible softened fabric and coated metal, painted edges, layered lived-in space, motivated local lighting. Reference image 2 is our new TOP-DOWN ROOM PLAN and material-colour guide, NOT the output style. Follow its functional layout, camera location and light directions. Ignore every diagram label, border, symbol and arrow; NO diagram or text in the final image. Do not reuse our old straight-row prefab composition. Paint a full cinematic 16:9 original game environment with professional spatial and furniture design.

A comfortable modest working/living expedition camp just outside a winter city about a century in the future. Approximately 6m wide and 4.2m deep, refined civilian postmodern modular construction with quiet insulated grey-white panels, softened corners and a few practical recessed fittings; not an ancient room or massive spaceship. Camera near the front-left at seated eye height, looking diagonally through the working group into the room. Correct human scales, two-point perspective and grounded contact.

FOREGROUND LEFT: a LARGE close upholstered grey-green rest chair, substantial back and armrest projecting diagonally toward the lower centre, one plain muted BLUE-GREY field jacket loosely draped over it. It must fill about the left quarter to third as a strong soft dark foreground frame, never become a tiny desk chair. Simplify upholstery into broad readable cloth planes rather than dense photographic weave. A small low side table at its inside edge with one simple pale ceramic drinking mug; a small desaturated OCHRE cushion gives this rest group a restrained distinct material colour.

MIDDLE, CENTRE-LEFT: a truly usable 1.8x0.8m planning desk, rotated about 15 degrees relative to the walls so its diagonal and the near armrest lead the eye to a clear work focal group near the middle of the picture. Modern thin structural legs and a WARM SAND/IVORY laminated top, no carved wood or patterned grain. The working chair is at the near-right side, turned slightly and partly under the desk, not blocking our view of the work surface. Main objects are one unfolded map, one open record folio partly overlapping its lower edge, one compact communication terminal resting at the far-right edge of the map, and one useful slim task lamp. Keep these objects within a seated person's reach, with real support/occlusion/contact shadows and free working tabletop. No miniature cases on the desk or independent box in knee space. Clear pulled-chair area separate from the walking route.

REAR LEFT: a compact independent drinking-water/tea alcove about 1.1m wide, with an integrated clean-water unit and one grouped thermos tray; quiet, no row of bottles. REAR RIGHT: one full-size 2m built-in sleeping berth along the back/right wall, gently rumpled off-white linen and a muted TERRACOTTA blanket, pillow slightly offset. This living group is softer and less sharply detailed, not a lineup of rigid boxes. FRONT-RIGHT at the entry side: one recessed graphite grey-green equipment storage unit, exactly TWO matching slate-grey cases together in its lower bay, same physical dimensions, colour and latch design, stored naturally rather than displayed. A clear 90cm route along the right side links entry, sleeping and tea areas and remains clear when the work chair is pulled out. RIGHT MIDDLE on a separate short wall segment: one compact enclosed modern fireplace with simple flue; visible fireproof gap and bare floor separate it from all bedding. Hearth is not a giant foreground lightbox. Avoid continuous shelf rows across the back wall. The room's empty spaces, grouped masses and overlap should look designed around people using them.

SPECIFIC COLOUR DESIGN: neutral warm grey-white walls; stone/graphite grey-green coated frames and cabinet; warm sand laminated desk; muted denim/slate-blue garment and cool reflected shadows; grey-teal chair upholstery; tiny ochre cushion and faded terracotta blanket; warm off-white paper/linen/ceramic. These materials must produce DISTINCT but comfortable midtone hue families like reference 1, not a uniformly brown or monochrome military cabin, not random rainbow objects. Matte surfaces, gentle reflected colour and painted form shading; restrained brush-layer variations and selective drawn edges, no uniformly outlined CG surfaces, noisy weathering, dense weave or glossy showroom floor.

PHYSICALLY COHERENT LIGHT: an insulated broad LEFT-SIDE window gives soft cool overcast winter daylight as the ONE dominant light source, wrapping adjacent furniture with broad soft shadows and cold reflected edge planes. No direct-sun sharp warm bands, disconnected ceiling/wall spotlights, mystery bright patches or global yellow filter. The desk lamp provides a SMALL warm-white local pool: map nearer lamp brighter, terminal gives a short contact/cast shadow, desk edge falls away. Tiny contained amber fire affects only nearby bare floor and the nearest side panel; use diffuse warm reflection, never a mirror image in the matte floor and never light passing through the bed partition. Near chair has readable cool window-side folds and darker opposite planes. Window brighter than room, but the middle work group is clearest; back storage/bed is quieter, warm/cool material colours remain visible. Outside only pale snow and a VERY faint low-contrast modern city as a few hazy blue-grey blocks: no mountains, trees, roads, sharp city windows or photographic blur. No indoor snow. No people, words, UI, logo, emblem, poster, flag, neon, weapon display, random cables, decorative plants or unnecessary gadgets. Original carefully art-directed painted game background.
